definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese three-stringed musical instrument played with a plectrum, used in various genres of traditional music.

examples.japanese: {三味線|しゃみせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{弾|ひ}く→弾く：02444_hiku⟧。
{津軽|つがる}{三味線|じゃみせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{力強|ちからづよ}い→力強い：03119_chikarazuyoi⟧。
⟦{歌舞伎|かぶき}→歌舞伎：04455_kabuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三味線|しゃみせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伴奏|ばんそう}→伴奏：06566_bansou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かせない：24096_kakasenai⟧。
examples.english: Shamisen accompaniment is essential for kabuki.

notes:
COMPOUND: {三|しゃ} (three) + {味|み} (taste) + {線|せん} (string) - though {味|み} refers to {撥味|ばちあじ} (plectrum feel)

ALTERNATE READING:
・{三味線|さみせん} - also correct

PARTS:
・⟦{胴|どう}→胴：noentry⟧ (body - covered with animal skin)
・⟦{棹|さお}→棹：24133_sao⟧ (neck)
・⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧ (strings)
・⟦{撥|ばち}→撥：20880_bachi⟧ (plectrum)

TYPES/STYLES:
・{津軽|つがる}{三味線|じゃみせん} (Tsugaru shamisen - powerful, fast)
・⟦{義太夫|ぎだゆう}→義太夫：28510_gidayuu⟧{三味線|じゃみせん} (for bunraku/joruri)
・⟦{長唄|ながうた}→長唄：28511_nagauta⟧{三味線|じゃみせん} (for kabuki)
・⟦{地唄|じうた}→地唄：noentry⟧{三味線|じゃみせん} (chamber music)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{三味線|しゃみせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{弾|ひ}く→弾く：02444_hiku⟧ (to play shamisen)
・{三味線|しゃみせん}⟦{奏者|そうしゃ}→奏者：06964_sousha⟧ (shamisen player)
